note: BAC only, as before: the other large issuers (Banco Industrial, Banrural, G&T Continental) weren't reached in this pass. BAC Guatemala's information on interest, late interest, fees and other charges on its credit cards (at 31 December 2025), read in full, prices its cards by brand and tier, not by name: Mastercard, Visa and American Express, each Clásica, Gold, Platinum and Black (the Business cards aren't written), in quetzales, at a nominal 24.00% (Mastercard) or 51.00% (Visa and American Express) to 64.80% a year, written at the top with the bottom as the range's lowest; a cash withdrawal fee of up to 5%, written at 5%; purchases in dollars carry up to 2% and in other currencies up to 3%, written as 3%; and a late charge of up to 300 quetzales, written at the top. The membership for access to benefits (up to 777 quetzales) is set by card and isn't written for the brand cards; the moratory rate is charged on top of the ordinary rate and isn't written as a penalty rate. The CashBack Restaurantes Visa Clásica's own page gives its membership: 247 quetzales a year from the second year (the first free is introductory), refunded on 9,000 quetzals of purchases in the year; it takes the Visa terms above. No minimum payment or grace period is stated. Wave 4 (30 October 2026) added Banco G&T Continental and Banco Promerica (its cards issued by Tarjetas Promerica, S.A.), two of the country's large card issuers, each through the annex on card interest, late interest, fees and other charges the regulation has every issuer publish. G&T Continental's (at 31 July 2026), read in full: its Visa (Clásica, Clásica Mujer, Oro, Platinum, Signature, Infinite, Infinite Metálica) and Mastercard (Clásica, Clásica Planet, Oro, Platinum, Black, Worldclass Black) personal cards, in quetzales, at a nominal 60.00% a year (5.00% a month); a cash withdrawal of 5.00%, at least 20 quetzales; a late payment charge of 280 quetzales; an overdraft charge of 196, written as the over-limit fee; 134.40 for a cheque returned. Its membership (46 to 450 dollars) is set by card, as at BAC, and isn't written; the administrative processing charges at 30, 60 and 90 days overdue and the extra-financing are collection or loan charges and aren't written; the late interest is charged on top and isn't written as a penalty rate. Promerica's (at 30 April 2026), read in full: its Visa Clásica, Oro, Platinum, Signature and Infinite (the Black shows no figures; the Empresarial is a business card), in quetzales, at a nominal 20.00% to 60.00% a year, written at the top with the bottom as the range's lowest; a cash withdrawal of up to 6.00%, at least 15 quetzales, written at 6%; up to 2.00% on spending abroad, written at 2%; an overdraft charge of 175 to 425, written at its top as the over-limit fee; 150 for a cheque returned. Its membership (350 to 2,400 quetzales) is set by card and isn't written, nor its collection charge (100 to 400 quetzales), which isn't stated to be the late payment charge. Neither states a minimum payment or grace period. Tried and not used: Banco Industrial's and Banco Agromercantil's sites sit behind Incapsula, Bantrab's behind a Cloudflare check, and the Superintendencia de Bancos refused the request (403); Banrural's home page links no card tariff.
